claim_text: At Lynas, safety is our first priority. This means we are focused on production that is safe for our people, safe for our communities, and safe for the environment.
metric_name: Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate (TRIFR); Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR); Fatalities
value_unit: per million hours worked；per million hours worked；fatalities
context_text: At Lynas, safety is our first priority. This means we are focused on production that is safe for our people, safe for our communities, and safe for the environment.；The 12-month rolling Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR) as at 30 June 2025 was 1.8 per million hours worked (June 2024: 1.04 per million hours worked). The 12-month Total Recordable Injury Frequency Rate (TRIFR) at 30 June 2025 was 3.6 per million hours worked (June 2024: 5.0 per million hours worked).；Safety performance FY21 FY22 FY23 FY24 FY25 Total Recordable Injury Frequency (TRIF) rate per million hours worked 2.1 2.4 3.2 5.0 3.6; Lost Time Injury Frequency (LTIF) rate per million hours worked 0.8 0.8 1.2 1.04 1.8; Fatalities 0 0 0 0 0.
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: 安全数据能部分支撑对“safe for our people”的表述，但仍有TRIFR 3.6和LTIFR 1.8，且没有直接量化证据支持“safe for our communities”与“safe for the environment”。
notes: 证据合并自安全章节与性能数据表。
